plan.method: Retain RCG unless (source OR scalar) both exclude a pixel AND bilinear(bg_max-fg_max)>0. Candidate absence alone contributes zero penalty.

controls.conservative_delete: Original RCG&(source|scalar), deletes every D_deleted pixel.
controls.FG_count_matched_delete: Delete exactly K pixels with smallest bilinear fg_max, restricted to the same D_deleted.
controls.RCG_count_matched_delete: Delete exactly K pixels with smallest bilinear RCG field, restricted to the same D_deleted.

plan.budget: K is the label-free number of proposed explicit_BG deletions per episode; same K for both matched controls. No GT-based budget or threshold.
plan.renderer: Stored64 bg-minus-fg computed in float64 then cast float32, torch bilinear to1024 align_corners=False; strict >0. Original FG and RCG fields follow samefloat32 renderer. Ranking ties are stable ascending row-major originalpixel index.
plan.scope: Exposed DEV220; fixed after first diagnostic signal. Every prediction frozen before this composition evaluation. No threshold grid, fit, new data or independent confirmation claim.
plan.evaluation: Complete1024 masks, native_cached_CRF comparator; old120/new100/combined220, folds, photograph-group RandomState0 paired2000 bootstrap and four-action counts.
plan.cost: One CPU/BLAS/Torch thread; saved diagnostic fields/masks only.
plan.nonclaim: Modest conditional AUC does not guarantee full-system gain.
